title: Harness-agnostic detection and immunization of reward hacking in self-evolving language models
abstract: arXiv:2609.04665v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-evolving language models improve by proposing candidate updates and keeping whatever raises a visible score. When that score is an imperfect proxy for the capability one actually wants, sustained selection widens the gap between the two. This is reward hacking. We introduce HackProbe, a monitor that attaches to an arbitrary self-evolving loop through two black-box hooks, with no access to weights or activations. It keeps a secret, distribution-fixed comparison core, whose frozen distribution makes its capability proxy comparable across generations, alongside a rotated fresh layer that hardens the bank against co-adaptation. Four tests built on that proxy cover the level gap, a scale-aligned divergence with online change-point detection, capability stagnation, and a conditional confidently-wrong rate; a Sidak correction turns them into a calibrated family-wise p-value. translated_title: 自进化语言模型中奖励破解的框架无关检测与免疫方法
translated_abstract: 自进化语言模型通过提出候选更新并保留任何能提升可见分数的更新来不断改进。当该分数只是人们实际想要的能力的不完美代理指标时，持续的选择会扩大两者之间的差距。这就是奖励破解（reward hacking）。我们提出了HackProbe，这是一种通过两个黑盒钩子附加到任意自进化循环的监控器，无需访问权重或激活值。它维护一个保密的、分布固定的比较核心，其冻结的分布使其能力代理指标在各个代际之间具有可比性，同时配合一个轮换的新鲜层来强化题库以对抗协同适应。基于该代理指标构建的四项测试涵盖了水平差距、带在线变点检测的尺度对齐散度、能力停滞以及条件性自信错误率；Šidák校正将它们转化为经过校准的族错误率p值。仅靠诊断无法恢复性能，因此还需要一种风险感知的免疫机制……
tldr: 提出HackProbe监控器，通过两个黑盒钩子以框架无关的方式检测自进化语言模型中的奖励破解行为，并配合风险感知的免疫机制来缓解该问题。
en_tdlr: HackProbe is a harness-agnostic monitor that detects reward hacking in self-evolving language models via two black-box hooks, paired with a risk-aware immunization mechanism to mitigate it.
